input: Lilanga lashona ngaphansi kwemkhatsi, lakhipha kukhanya lokufutfumele etitaladini letiphitsitelako telidolobha. Bantfu bebaphutfuma bahamba eceleni kwetindlela, tinyawo tabo betiphindzaphindza epheyivumentini njengobe tingcoco tihlangana tibe kububula. Emakhefini, liphunga lelikhofi lelisandza kuphekwa belihlangana neliphunga letimphahla letibhakiwe, limema bantfu labendlulako kutsi bame kancane futsi batijabulise. Badlali labasemgwacweni bangeta kuqhuma kwemculo nesigci, kwesikhashana bagucula lelidolobha laba yi-tapestry lephilako yemsindvo nembala. Njengobe besekuhlwa, tibane talelidolobha beticwebetela, tikhanyisa umdanso loyinkimbinkimbi wekuphila kwasemadolobheni longazange ume mbamba.

Ngale kwendzawo lenkhulu yemagcuma lagingcikako kanye nemahlatsi laluhlata, umoya bewuhleba timfihlo ngemacembe. Tilwane tasendle betigijima ngaphansi kwempheme, kuhamba kwato bekuyi-ballet lethulile leyentiwa ngaphansi kweliso lelibukhali lesibhakabhaka. Umfudlana bewujikeleta kancane kulendzawo, indzawo yawo beyikhombisa kukhanya kwelilanga lokunemabala futsi kwenta emaphethini lacwebetelako lajabulisa liso. Tinyoni betihlabela imiculo lebeyibonakala ilandzisa indzaba yemhlaba wemvelo, umculo wekuphila lobewuvakala ekuthuleni. Kulendzawo lethulile, sikhatsi besibonakala sihamba kancane, sivumela tikhatsi tekucabangisisa nekuthula kutsi tichume.

Ngekhatsi kwemtapo lomkhulu, emashelufu abelulwe angapheli, agcwele tincwadzi tato tonkhe tifundvo longaticabanga. Liphunga lemaphepha lagugile kanye netibopho tesikhumba kwagcwala emoyeni, kwamema bahloli belwati kutsi bajule emihlabeni lengabalwa. Bafundzi bebahlala etindzaweni letifutfumele nasematafuleni lamakhulu, emehlo abo abuka emakhasi njengobe tingcondvo tabo tizulazula ngemibono, tindzaba, kanye nasetintfweni letitfolakele. Ngalesinye sikhatsi, umsindvo wekuvula emakhasi bewufaka umsindvo lothulile wekugcila. Ngaphandle, umhlaba wachubeka nekugijima kwawo, kepha ngaphakatsi kwaletibondza, indzawo yonkhe yekuhlakanipha nekucabanga kwachuma ngekuthulisa lokuvumelanako.

Emakethe lebeyiphitsitela, batsengisi bebamemeta iminikelo yabo, baphikisana kutsi banakwe emkhatsini wemisindvo lephitsitelako. Titolo betigcwele titselo letiphilako, tinongo letinephunga lelimnandzi, kanye netindvwangu letimibalabala, intfo ngayinye beyikhuluma indzaba yemvelaphi kanye nemisebenti yetandla. Batsengi bebatsengisa ngemanani futsi bashintjana ngetindzaba, kwenta umdvwebo lophilako wekuchumana kwebantfu. Liphunga lenyama leyosiwe kanye nemakhekhe lamnandzi belihamba emoyeni, lilinga bantfu labendlulako kutsi batijabulise. Emkhatsini walesiphitsiphitsi, bekunesigci lesingaphansi — ipulse lebeyigcina imakethe iphila futsi idvumile, bufakazi bemoya lohlala njalo wemmango.

Kulolwandle lolukhulu, emagagasi ashaya umtimba wemkhumbi, atfumela tifutfo temanti laneluswayi emoyeni. Lelicembu lahamba ngenjongo, lilungisa imikhumbi futsi lihamba endzaweni lenkhulu leluhlata sasibhakabhaka, licondziswa tinkhanyeti kuphela kanye nekucondza lokunesikhatsi. Umkhatsi bewululeka ungapheli, likhanvasi lemibala leshintjako kusukela ekuseni kuya ekuseni, leveta buhle bemhlaba lobungenamkhawulo. Ema- seagull abejikeleta etulu, kubita kwawo bekuvakala ngaphesheya kwemanti, kwengeta kumculo wemisindvo yaselwandle. Noma nje lwandle belulodwa, umuva wekutsi ungatsatsa sinyatselo kanye nekutfola tintfo bewuchuma emkhatsini wemkhatsi longapheli.

Enhlitiyweni yepaki yelidolobha lebeyiphitsitela, kuhleka kwebantfwana bekuvakala njengobe badlala ema-swings nasema-slide. Imindeni beyiphikisa ngetingubo letisakateke etjanini, bacoca tindzaba futsi bajabulela kuhlala ndzawonye ngaphansi kwemtfunti wetihlahla letiphakeme. Bagijimi kanye nebagibeli bemabhayisikili bebahamba etindleleni letijikeletako, kunyakata kwabo kwenta sigci sekuthula kwemvelo emkhatsini wemphilo yasemadolobheni. Emadada kanye nema swans bekushelela ngemusa emhlabatsini welichibi, kwengeta esimeni sekuthula. Njengobe lilanga beliphela, lelipaki lagucuka laba yindzawo lethulile lapho khona bantfu labahlala edolobheni bebatfola kuphumula etinhlelweni tabo letimatasatasa.

Lesicumbi sentsaba besiniketa umbono lomangalisako wetigodzi letitungeletile kanye neticoco letikhashane. Bagibeli bebahlangana batungelete imililo lemincane, bacoca tindzaba teluhambo lwabo kanye nemaphupho etikhatsi letitako. Umoya bewucwebetela futsi uvuselela, ugcwalisa emaphaphu ngemoya-mpilo lohlantekile, lovuselelako. Emabala elichwa anamatsele emithambekeni lenemadvwala, acwebetela ngaphansi kwekukhanya kwelanga lokukhanyako, aphambene nemhlaba lomnyama kanye netitjalo letincane letingephansi. Njengobe emafu abedlula, titfunti betidlala kuyo yonkhe lendzawo, tigcizelela buhle bendzawo lembi. Eme etulu kwemhlaba, umuntfu weva kuchumana lokujulile nebukhulu bemvelo lobungapheli sikhatsi.

Endzaweni lethulile lesemadolobheni, imindeni beyenta imikhuba yayo ngesigci lesimnene. Bantfwana bebadlala i-hopscotch eceleni kwetindlela, kuhleka kwabo bekukhala emoyeni njengobe batali bebabuka ngekucophelela basemaveranda lasedvute. Tingadze taqhakaza ngesiphitsiphitsi semibala — ema rose, ema tulips, ema daisies — konkhe kuncintisana ngekukhanya kwelanga kanye nekunakwa. Liphunga letjani lobusanda kujutjwa kanye netimbali letiqhakazako kwenta umoya lomemako lowafaka ekhatsi umcondvo wasekhaya. Kusihlwa kwaletsa kukhanya lokuncane kwemalambu emigwaco kanye nemuva wekuchubeka ngekuthula lokuvame kungabonakali kepha lokutsatfwa njengalokubalulekile.

Emadvumbu asendvulo abekhuluma tindzaba temphucuko leseyiphelile, tindvonga tabo tematje betigugile kodvwa betibeketela. Emavini kanye ne moss bekunyonyoba eceleni kwemifantu, kuveta kuhamba kwesikhatsi kanye nekubuyisa kwemvelo kwetintfo letidaliwe tebantfu. Bahloli bebazulazula ngetindlela letigobile kanye nemagceke, bacabanga ngekuphila lebekuke kwaphilwa ngaphakatsi kwaletakhiwo. Lokuthula bekukujulile, kuphazanyiswa kuphela umsindvo wetinyawo kanye nekubita kwenyoni lokukhashane. Njengoba lilanga lishona ngemuva kwematje, titfunti takhula, tifaka umoya wemfihlakalo kanye nekuhlonipha kulendzawo. Bekusikhumbuto sekuba khona kwemlandvo lokuhlala njalo kanye netindzaba letifakwe kuwo onkhe ematje.

Esikhumulweni setindizamshini lesiphitsitelako, bahambi bebaphutfuma badlula ngemizwa yekulindzela nekulangatelela. Emasondvo emithwalo abekhala phansi lokucwebetelako njengobe kucocwa ngetilwimi letinyenti kakhulu bekugcwala emoyeni. Tikrini tedijithali betikhanya tikhatsi tekuhamba nekufika, ticondzisa bagibeli labaphelelwa sineke nobe labajabulile kutsi baye lapho bebaya khona. Tinkomishi telikhofi kanye netigoco tekudla lokulula bekugcwele emakhona lamanye, bufakazi bekudla kwasekuseni lokuphutfumako kanye nekulungiselela ngemzuzu wekugcina. Emkhatsini wesiphitsiphitsi lesihleliwe, bekunekuvisisa lokuhlanganyelwe — umzuzu losheshako wekuhlangana emkhatsini webantfu labangabati lababoshwe sifiso lesifanako sekuhlola, kubuya, noma kufuna sicalo lesisha. Loluhambo beluhlala lutawuchubeka nje.

Kulesihlenge lesihle, emagagasi lamnene ahlasela emagcekeni lanesihlabathi lesihlantekile, amema kuphumula kanye nekucabangisisa. Tihlahla temasundu betinyakata ngebuvila emoyeni waselwandle, imifanekiso yato beyiphambene nesibhakabhaka lesikhanyako. Bantfu labahamba ebhishi bebageza lilanga, bakha tinqaba tesihlabathi, futsi babutsela ndzawonye emagobolondo elwandle, benta tintfo letilula lebetifaka ekhatsi lipharadesi. Ngaphansi kwemanti, emadvwala laphilako bekagcwele tilwane taselwandle letimibalabala, lebetibonakala ngemanti lahlobile labeveta umhlaba lofihlekile wekumangalisa. Njengobe bekusondzela kusihlwa, umkhatsi bewubovu ngemibala le-orange ne-pink, lokukhombisa kuphela kwalelinye lilanga kulendzawo lethulile. Buhle balesihlenge lobuthulile bebuniketa indzawo lengcwele lekhashane nemsindvo wekuphila kwamalanga onkhe.

Esakhiweni semahhovisi esimanje, tisebenti betibambisana kuwo onkhe emagumbi enkomfa lanelubondza lwengilazi kanye netindzawo tekusebenta letivulekile. Kukhala kwemakhompyutha kanye nekukhala kwemafoni kwenta umsindvo lohlale ukhona ngemuva, lobewubhalwa ngekuchafata emakhibhodi kanye nekushushumbisa emaphepha. Emagumbi ekuphumula aniketa tikhatsi tekuphumula, nebalingani bahlanganyela likhofi kanye nengcoco levamile. Emabhodi lamhlophe netikrini bekukhombisa emashadi, imigca yesikhatsi yephrojekthi, kanye nemibono lehambako, konkhe kusebentela imigomo lefanako. Noma bekumatasatasa, bekunemuva wenjongo kanye nekusungula lokuchaza kulandzelela kwesimanje kwenchubekelembili nemphumelelo.

Siteshi sesitimela lesiphitsitelako sasebenta njengendlela yekuhlanganisa kuhamba, lapho khona tindzaba letinyenti kakhulu betihlangana khona. Bagibeli bebaphutfuma bayobamba titimelane tabo, babambe tikhwama netikhwama tetincwadzi, ngamunye unendzawo laya kuyo nemaphupho. Batsengisi bebatsengisa kudla lokulula kanye nemaphephandzaba eceleni kwemakhawunta emathikithi laphindzaphindza ngemavi netimemetelo. Lepulatifomu beyidvudvuta ngekulindzela njengobe tinjini betibhodla tiphila, tikhombisa kuhamba nekufika. Kulesikhala sesikhashana, tikhatsi tekuchumana nekuvalelisa tahlangana, tiphindzaphindza tigcizelelo temphilo yemalanga onkhe emhlabeni longazange uyekele kuhamba.

Ekujuleni kwelihlatsi, kukhanya kwelilanga bekuhlunga ngempheme wemacembe, kulahlela emaphethini lanemabala emhlabatsini lotsambile longentasi. Tidalwa tato tonkhe tinhlobo betihamba tithule endzaweni yato yekuhlala, ngayinye idlala indzima yayo kuwebhu leyinkimbinkimbi yekuphila. Umoya bewucebile ngeliphunga le moss, pine, kanye nemhlabatsi lomanti, lokuvusa umuva wekusimamisa kwasendvulo. Umfudlana lomnene bewujikeleta etihlahleni, kubhubha kwawo bekusebenta njengemculo lopholisako loya ehlane lelithulile. Lendzawo lengcwele lengakatsintfwa yahlala iyibufakazi bekucinisela kwemvelo kanye nebuhle lobuhlala njalo betindzawo letingakatsintwa.

Likhishi lelimatasatasa beligcwele umsebenti njengobe bapheki bebalungisa tidlo letinyenti kakhulu. Imisindvo levutsako levela emaskillet lehlanganiswe neliphunga lemakhambi, tinongo, kanye nesinkhwa lesisanda kubhaka, kwenta indzawo lehehanako. Titsako beticotjwa, tivutsiwe, futsi tifakwe tinongo ngekuciniseka, ngayinye beyifaka sandla ekuvumelaneni kwekunambitseka. Tisebenti tahamba ngaphandle kwemthungo emkhatsini wetiteshi, tihlanganisa kucinisekisa kutsi ipuleti ngalinye lifinyelela ekupheleleni. Tivakashi betilindzele kudla kwato, kwakha kulindzela njengoba tintfo letidaliwe tekupheka tihlangana — sidlo ngasinye umsebenti webuciko loklanyelwe kujabulisa imiva kanye nekwenetisa umphefumulo.

Egalari yebuciko, tindvonga betihlotjiswe ngemifanekiso leyehlukahlukene, tintfo letibatiwe, kanye netitfombe. Tivakashi betihamba kancane kusuka eceleni kuya eceleni, ngamunye wema kute ahumushe futsi abonge imibono yebaculi. Lokukhanya bekugcizelela kuhlanganiswa kanye nemininingwane, kwenta kutsi lemisebenti yebuciko iphile. Tinkhulumo letithulile mayelana nebuchwepheshe, imiva, kanye nenshokutsi kwengeta kujula kulokuhlangenwe nako. Lendzawo beyiyindzawo lengcwele yekudala kanye nekucabangisisa, lapho khona emandla ekuveta lokubonwako akhutsata imibono lemisha futsi aphefumulela umcabango.

Ngesikhatsi sekuseni kakhulu esizibeni, inkhungu yakhuphuka kancane kusuka etulu kwemanti, kwenta umoya we ethereal. Emadada abegwedla ngebuvila, ashiya emagagasi ekuvukeni kwawo, kantsi ema dragonflies agijima ngetulu kwemhlanga. Kuthula kwekusa kwaphulwa kuphela ngumsindvo lothambile wetinyoni letihlabelako letemukela lilanga. Tihlahla letitungeletile betibonakala emantini lathulile, tiphindza kabili umuva wekuthula. Lomzuzu lothulile bewufaka buhle lobuthulile bemvelo ngaphambi kwekutsi umhlaba uvuke ngalokuphelele, usikhumbute ngesigci lesinekuthula lesikhona emjikelezweni wemvelo.

Tibane tendzawo yemidlalo yafiphala ngesikhatsi likhethini likhuphuka, kwaveta sigaba lebesibekelwe umdlalo longakhohlwakali. Abalingisi bangena etindzaweni tabo, bahlanganisa balingisi ngenshisekelo nekuciniseka, baletsa indzaba ekuphileni. Tilaleli betitsatfwa, kuhleka nekushaya tandla kwabeka tikhatsi letibuhlungu kanye nekujika lokumangalisako. Umculo kanye nekukhanya kwenta ncono imiva kanye nemoya, kwagucula sikhala saba yindzawo yekucabanga nekumangala. Njengobe lesento besiphetsa, kwaba nekushaywa kwetandla, kugujwa buciko kanye nemitamo leyenta lomdlalo waba yintfo lengakhohlakali kubo bonkhe bantfu.

Emadolobhaneni lathulile, tindlu betime ngemigca lecocekile, ngayinye beyinesimi sayo lebesigcwele timbali neluhlata. Titaladi betigcwele buso lobujwayelekile kanye nekuvuma ngebungani, lokufaka umuva wemmango kanye nekusimama. Bantfwana bebadlala emabaleni kantsi bantfu labadzala bebavame kwenta imisebenti yekusita ekhaya nobe bacoce emaveranda. Kuhubha lokumnene kwemphilo yemalanga onkhe kwakha sendlalelo lesidvudvutako, kugcizelela kubaluleka kwelikhaya kanye nekuxhumana. Njengobe bekuhlwa, kukhanya lokutsambile kwetibane tempheme kwemukela busuku, kwahlala esigcini lesinekuthula sekuphila emadolobheni lasemaphandleni.

Umzila wetintsaba bewujikeleta etulu ngendzawo lenemagagasi, uyinsayeya kubahambi betintsaba labanetindzawo letiphakeme kanye netindzawo letinemadvwala. Sinyatselo ngasinye besidzinga umtamo nekutimisela, bekuvuzwa ngemibono lemangalisako kulomhlangano. Umoya lopholile wasetintsabeni bewuvuselela imiva, kantsi timbali tesiganga netitjalo leticinile tinamatsele emifantfweni yemadvwala. Ngalesinye sikhatsi, kukhala kwelusweti lokukhashane nobe kubona imbuti yasetintsabeni bekukhumbuta bantfu labafuna kuhamba ngebuhle besiganga lobubatungeletile. Kufika esicongweni kwaba ngumzuzu wekuncoba, bufakazi bekuphikelela kanye nemandla emvelo lamangalisako.

Imakethe kulelidolobha lasendvulo beyiyindzawo lenemisebenti leminyenti, batsengisi bebamemeta tintfo tabo futsi emakhasimende abebonisana ngekujabula. Titolo betigcwele tintfo letentiwe ngesandla, tinongo, kanye netindvwangu, intfo ngayinye beyimele sicucu selifa lelicebile lemasiko alelidolobha. Liphunga lekudla lokungakavami lagcwala emoyeni, lilinga bantfu labendlulako kutsi banambitse tinongo letinsha. Imisindvo yemculo kanye nekudansa lokuvela kubadlali labasedvute kwengeta emoyeni lomdlandla. Lendzawo lebeyiphitsitela beyingetulu nje kwendzawo yekuhweba; bekuyindlela yekuhlangana kwemlandvo, emasiko, kanye nekuhlangana kwebantfu.

Ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka ebusuku, umlilo wekhempu bewucwebetela ufaka titfunti letidansako ebusweni bebahambi labakhatsele. Bebahlanganyela tindzaba futsi bahlabela tingoma, bajabula ngenjabulo lelula yekuba nebangani. Lomlilo locwebetelako bewuniketa kufutfula emoyeni lopholile, kantsi tinkhanyeti letingetulu betiniketa licanvas lasezulwini lekumangalisa lokungapheli. Kubita kwesikhova lokukhashane kanye nekukhala lokuncane kwemacembe kwakha sendlalelo lesipholisako. Kulomzuzu, utungeletwe yimvelo nebangani, sikhatsi besibonakala simile, sigcizelela kuheha lokungapheli kwetikhatsi tekuhamba ngaphandle.

Lengcungcutsela yetifundvo ihlanganise ndzawonye tati letivela emhlabeni wonkhe kute tihlanganyele imibono futsi ticoce ngetintfo letinsha. Tikhulumi letiyinhloko tetfule tinkhulumo letikhutsatako, tavutsa imigca lemisha yekuphenya nekubambisana. Tikhatsi tekuphumula tikhutsate inkhulumomphendvulwano lesebentisanako, kukhutsata ummango wetingcondvo letifuna kwati. Kushintjana ngelwati kwagcwaliswa yimicimbi yekuchumana kanye nemisebenti yemasiko, kucebisa lwati ngale kwetifundvo. Njengobe lenkhomfa iphetsa, bahlanganyeli bachubela embili imibono lemisha kanye nekubambisana lokungenteka, lokukhutsata inchubekelembili emikhakheni yabo.

Imvula lemnene yawela edolobheni, yakha umpompi lonesigci emafasiteleni nasetindlini letiphakeme. Bahambi ngetinyawo bebaphutfuma ngaphansi kwetimbungulu, tinyatselo tabo betiphutfuma kodvwa tingaphutfumi, njengobe imifanekiso beyicwebetela emgwacweni lomanti. Liphunga lemhlaba lomanti kanye nemvula lensha kwavuselela imiva, kuniketa umzuzu wekuvuselela emkhatsini wemphilo yasemadolobheni. Tibane temigwaco tikhanya ngeligolide, letingafani nesibhakabhaka lesipholile lesimphunga, lengeta kufutfula lokutfokotisako kulendzawo. Imphumuzo nekuthula kwatsatsa sikhundla sekuphitsitela kwasekucaleni, njengoba lelidolobha lamukela kuvunywa kwemvula lokupholisako, lokukhumbuta wonkhe umuntfu ngemandla emnene emvelo.

Lelithempeli lasendvulo belime njengesivumelwano sebuciko bebantfu kanye nemoya, tindvonga talo tematje betiguculwe ngemakhulu eminyaka emoya kanye nesimo selitulu. Tintfo letibatiwe letiyinkimbinkimbi kanye netitfombe bekuhlobisa emafacades ayo, kuhleba tindzaba tekutinikela kanye netinganekwane. Ema Pilgrims kanye netivakashi ngekufana batfola indvudvuto kanye nekugcugcutela ngaphakatsi kwetikhala tayo letithulile, lapho khona kuthula kanye nekuhlonipha kwagcwala emoyeni. Kubakhona kwalelithempeli bekuhlanganisa sikhatsi lesengcile nalesikhona nyalo, kusebenta njengesikhumbuto lesingcwele selifa lemasiko kanye nekufuna inchazelo lokuhlala njalo. Njengoba kukhanya kwelilanga bekuhlunga emifantfweni nasemifantfweni, umuva wekungaphelelwa sikhatsi wawumbonya lendzawo.

Lomkhosi lophilako bewungumbukiso wemibala, umsindvo, kanye nenjabulo. Emagibeli abejikeleta futsi akhuphuka, agcwele kumemeta kwenjabulo, ngesikhatsi tindzawo tekudlala tiniketa ematfuba emiklomelo kanye nekuhleka. Badlali labagcoke timphahla bajabulisa ticumbi tebantfu ngema-acrobatics, emacebo emilingo, kanye netento temculo, batsatsa umcabango wabo bonkhe bantfu labaneminyaka leyehlukene. Liphunga le-cotton candy, i-popcorn, kanye nemasoseji lashisiwe laheha lababekhona kutsi batijabulise. Njengobe bekuhwalala, tibane letikhanyako kanye nemculo kwakha umoya lonemndlandla lobewugubha injabulo, ummango, kanye netijabulisa letilula tekuphila.

Ekhoneni lemtapolwati lelithulile, lideski linye belikhanyisiwe sibane, limema umfundzi kutsi alahlekelwe nguye encwadzini. Emakhasi abephetse imihlaba yekuhlakanipha, lwati, kanye nemiva, ngamunye umnyango wekuvisisa lokusha noma kubaleka. Kuthula lokukhona kwakhutsata kugcila kanye nekucabangisisa, indzawo lengcwele kusuka esiphitsiphitsini lesingaphandle. Edvute, emashelufu lahlelwe sihloko kanye nembhali waniketa tapestry ecebile umcabango webantfu kanye nekusungula. Lendzawo yekufuna kwati yakhombisa emandla lahlala njalo ekufundza ekugcugcuteleni, ekufundziseni, nasekuguculeni.

Lesivini besiwela emagcuma lagucukagucuka, emavini aso abesindza ngemagilebisi lavutsiwe lalungele kuvunwa. Tisebenti betihamba ngendlela emkhatsini wemigca, tisika futsi ticosha, ngamunye bekanakekela umhlaba ngekunakekela kanye nebungcweti. Lilanga lifaka umbala weligolide kulendzawo leluhlata, ligcizelela luhlata loluphilako kanye nebubende lobujulile. Umoya bewugcwele liphunga lelimnandzi letitselo nemhlabatsi, lelifaka ekhatsi umcondvo wemphilo yekulima. Njengoba sikhatsi sekuvuna sasondzela, kulindzela kwakhula emawayini labesatawukhicitwa kulamacembu laligugu.

Lelidolobha lebelimbonywe lichwa bekuyindzawo lephelele yasebusika, neluphahla lolumbonywe ngetintfo letimhlophe kanye nema icicles lalenga ema eaves. Titaladi betithulile, tifihliwe kuwa lokuncane kwelichwa, lokwakha kuthula lokunekuthula. Bantfwana bebakha bantfu belichwa futsi bebalwa ngemabhola eliqhwa, kuhleka kwabo bekukhala emoyeni locijile. Tibane letifutfumele letivela etindlini letincane nasetitolo beticatsanisa kahle nendzawo lebandzako, tivusa umuva wekujabula lofutfumele. Yonkhe lendzawo beyibonakala icwebetela ngemlingo walesikhatsi, imema bonkhe kutsi bamukele kuthula kwesikhatsi sasebusika.

Kulelidolobha leliphitsitelako lelinelichweba, imikhumbi letfwala titfwalo kanye netikebhe tekudoba betihamba ngetinyawo echwebeni, ema- mast ato afika esibhakabhakeni. Tisebenti tasemadokodo betihamba ngekushesha, tilayisha futsi tehlisa timphahla lebetikhutsata umnotfo walelidolobha futsi letiwuhlanganisa nemhlaba wonkhe. Titolo temakethe letiseceleni kwe quay betiniketa tintfo letinsha letibanjiwe, imisebenti yetandla, kanye netikhumbuto tebahambi kanye nebantfu bendzawo ngekufana. Liphunga lemanti laneluswayi, kudla kwaselwandle, kanye nadizili lokuhlanganiswe emoyeni, kufaka ekhatsi kuphila kwemphilo yaselwandle. Njengobe imikhumbi beyihamba nobe ifika, lelidolobha belichuma ngekuhamba, ngekuhweba, kanye nekudvonswa lokubeketelako kwelwandle.

Buciko bekubhaka bebugcwalisa lendzawo yekubhaka ngeliphunga lelifutfumele, lelimemako lebelibita bantfu labendlulako kutsi bangene ngekhatsi. Sinkhwa lesisanda kubhakwa kanye nemakhekhe bekuhlelwa ngebuciko emakheyisini ekubonisa, emacembe ato eligolide kanye netinhlayiya letibucayi betilinga tinzwa. Babhaki bebahhubha njengobe bebabhuca inhlama futsi benta tinkhwa, likhono labo belibonakala kuyo yonkhe imininingwane. Emakhasimende ajabulela indzawo lefutfumele, anambitsa kudla lokunelikhofi noma litiye, abelana ngetingcoco ngetintfo letijabulisako letibhakiwe. Lomsebenti wekupheka bewungagcini nje ngekondla kepha bewuhlanganisa bantfu ngemasiko, ngekudala, kanye nenjabulo lelula yekudla lokuhle.

Emkhatsini wemhlangano wekusebenta lophitsitelako, ema-artisans asebenta ngekutimisela kumaphrojekthi abo, sicucu ngasinye besikhombisa likhono kanye nelutsandvo. Tintfo betisukela etigodvweni nensimbi kuya endvwangu nasebumba, ngetingcweti letigucula tintfo letiluhlata tibe buciko lobusebentako. Imisindvo yemasaha, emasando kanye netiluko beyihlangana yaba ngumculo wekudala. Tivakashi betitsandza umsebenti wetandla, tivame kuphefumulelwa kutsi tichubeke nemisebenti yato yebuciko. Lomhlangano wekucocisana bewufakazela buhlakani bebantfu kanye nekukhanga lokuhlala njalo kwetintfo letentiwe ngesandla, letinenshokutsi.

Ngesikhatsi semkhosi lonemdlandla, tintanta letihlotjiswe ngetimbali netibane betihamba etitaladini, tigubha emagugu emasiko kanye nemoya wemmango. Badlali labagcoke timphahla badansa futsi badlala umculo, bahlanganyela netibukeli tato tonkhe tinhlobo teminyaka. Titolo tekudla betiniketa kudla lokumnandzi kwesintfu, kwabelana ngekunambitseka lokuvela etitukulwaneni letengcile. Umoya bewudvuma ngenjabulo, kuhleka, kanye nenjabulo lehlanganisiwe yekuhlanganyela. Njengoba sekuhwalala, tikhali temlilo takhanyisa sibhakabhaka, kwaphawula umvuthwandaba wemcimbi lophilako, longakhumbulekako lowahlanganisa bantfu ndzawonye ekugubheni.

Emaphandleni lathulile bekayindzawo lehlanganisiwe yemasimu nemahlatsi, lapho sikhatsi besibonakala sihamba kancane khona. Balimi bebatsandza tintjalo kanye nemfuyo, imikhuba yabo beyisekelwe emakhulwini eminyaka emasiko. Emadolobha lamancane lahlala emkhatsini weluhlata, anetindlu letincane lebetikhipha bukhazikhazi be-rustic. Imisindvo lemnene yemvelo — tinyoni letihlabela, umoya loshaya emacembe, umsindvo wenkhomo lokhashane — kwakha umculo lopholisako. Lendzawo lebukeka kahle beyiniketa indzawo yekuphumula kusuka ekuphitsiteleni kwemphilo yasemadolobheni, ikhumbuta tivakashi ngekuthula kanye nekuba melula lokutfolakala ekwamukeleni kwemvelo.

Esibhedlela salamuhla, bantfu labasebenta ngekunakekelwa kwemphilo bebasebenta ngekutikhandla kute banakekele tigulane, kutinikela kwabo bekubonakala kuko konkhe labakwentako. Lendzawo lengakagcini beyiyindzawo yemsebenti, lapho khona bahlengikati nabodokotela bebahlanganisa kwelashwa kanye nekugadza timphawu letibalulekile. Buchwepheshe lobutfutfukile benta kutsi kube lula kuhlola kanye nekululama, lokufaka ekhatsi kuhlangana kweluvelo kanye nekusungula. Tigulane tatfola indvudvuto ebuchwephesheni nasemusa wetisebenti, tetsemba inhloso yato yekubuyisela imphilo nenhlalakahle. Lesikhala bekusivumelwano sekucinisela kwebantfu kanye nekulandzelela lokuchubekako kwekwelashwa.

Lelihlane belilule lingapheli, indzawo lenkhulu lenetindvundvuma tesihlabathi kanye netindzawo letinemadvwala ngaphansi kwelilanga lelivutsako. Bahambi bebahamba kulendzawo ngekucaphela, bebati bungoti nebuhle lobuhlangene kulelihlane. Ema Mirages bekacwebetela khashane, tintfo letikhohlisako lebetidlala emehlweni kepha tikhuphula imfihlakalo yalendzawo. Kushona kwelilanga kwagucula ludzaka lwaba likhanvasi lelibovu lelivutsako kanye nemawolintshi, umbukiso lodlulako wemandla emvelo laluhlata kanye nebuhle lobukhulu.

Lendlu lefutfumele lebeyisemkhatsini wetihlahla letiphakeme beyiniketa indzawo lengcwele levela emhlabeni wangaphandle. Tivakashi betihlala tifundza tincwadzi nobe tihlanganyela tindzaba, tijabulela kuthula kwekuphumula kwato. Lendzawo lesondzelene beyifaka ekhatsi kuhlehlela emuva kube melula kanye nendvudvuto letfolakala ekugomeni kwemvelo, kubaleka lokuphelele kwekuphumula kanye nekuvuselela.

Enkhundleni yethiyetha yasedolobheni lephilako, balingisi bebalungiselela ngemuva kwesiteji, luvalo lwabo kanye nenjabulo yabo bekubonakala. Le- orchestra yalungisa tinsimbi tayo njengobe kushaywa tandla kanye nekucocisana bekugcwala ehholo. Ngesikhatsi likhethini liphakama, sigaba besigucuka saba ngumhlaba wemidlalo, emahlaya, nobe inhlekelele, sitsatsa tilaleli futsi sivusa imiva. Bunye bekusebenta — balingisi, baculi, licembu lesiteji — wadala umsebenti webuciko losheshako lowawukhona kuphela ngalowo mzuzu. Njengobe sigameko sekugcina saphetsa futsi kwashaywa tandla, umlingo wethiyetha wakhumbuta wonkhe umuntfu emandla ekucoca tindzaba kanye nekuveta imiva yebantfu.

Ibala le monastery lelinekuthula bekuyindzawo yekucabangisisa nekuthula. Tinyanga betihamba buthule ema cloisters, tinakekela tingadze futsi tilungiselela imithandazo yemalanga onkhe. Liphunga lemphepho kanye netimbali letiqhakazako kwangeta esimeni sakamoya, kwakhutsata kucabanga kanye nekuthula. Tivakashi noma bahlali batfola indvudvuto ngekubalula kanye nekucondziswa kwemphilo ye monastic, lapho khona kuzindla kanye nemmango bekuhlangana. Lendzawo lengcwele beyimiswe emasikweni laneminyaka lengemakhulu lamakhulu, beyiniketa indzawo lengcwele yemphefumulo emkhatsini wesiphitsiphitsi semhlaba wangaphandle.

Kulendzawo yekwakha lebeyiphitsitela, tisebenti tahlanganisa imizamo yekwakha sakhiwo lesisha, ngamunye wabo wanikela ngebungcweti bakhe. Kukhala kwensimbi kanye nekukhala kwemishini bekukhombisa inchubekelembili, kantsi imigomo yekuphepha igcina wonkhe umuntfu avikelekile. Tintfo tafika emfudlaneni locinile — ukhonkolo, imisebe yensimbi, titini — incenye ngayinye lebalulekile ebucotfweni bephrojekthi. Bakhi bemakhiwo nabonjiniyela bebacondzisa lomsebenti, bacinisekisa kutsi lomklamo wentiwa ngekwetsembeka. Lendzawo beyisivumelwano sekufisa kwebantfu kanye nemtamo wekubambisana lodzingekako kute kuguculwe tinhlelo tibe liciniso.

Lelidvwala lelidvumile le- coral beligcwele tintfo letiphilako ngaphansi kwemanti lahlobile elwandle. Tikolo tetimfishi letimibalabala betigijima emkhatsini wemagala emakhorali, kantsi tifudvu taselwandle letinemusa betishelela. Lendzawo leyinkimbinkimbi yale reef beyisekela tinhlobo letinyenti tetilwane, ngayinye idlala indzima lebalulekile ekugcineni kulinganisela. Bantfu lababhukushako kanye nebantfu lababhukushako bahlola lelipharadesi lelingaphansi kwemanti, bebamangaliswa buhle balo kanye nekuhlukahluka kwalo. Kuvikela letindzawo tekuhlala letibutsakatsaka bekubalulekile ekugcineni bunjinga bemphilo yaselwandle etitukulwaneni letitako.

Ethempelini lemaBuddha lebelinekuthula, tinyanga betenta imikhosi futsi tizindla, kwenta kutsi kube nekuthula kanye nekugcila etintfweni takamoya. Titfombe kanye netitfombe tabonkulunkulu bekuniketa tindzawo letibalulekile tekuthandaza kanye nekuzindla, kukhutsata umuva wekuhlangana kanye nekuhlonipha. Tivakashi lebetifuna kuthula nekucondza tatfola indvudvuto ekuthuleni lokungapheli kwelithempeli. Tikhala letingcwele letinjalo betisebenta njengetindzawo tekuhlola ngekhatsi kanye nekuhlakulela luvelo.

Lendzawo yekushushuluza lebeyiphilako beyigcwele umsebenti njengobe bantfu labashushuluzako kanye nebashushuluti beliqhwa bebahamba emithambekeni lenelichwa kanye netindlela letisetintsabeni. Titulo letiphakamisako betitsatsa tivakashi titiyise etincotsheni, tiniketa imibono lebonakalako yendzawo lembonywe lichwa. Ngemuva kwelilanga lekujabula, tivakashi betihlangana ema lodge lafutfumele, bacoca tindzaba futsi batifutfumalisa ngemililo levutsako. Liphunga lashokolethi loshisako kanye nekudla lokumnandzi kwagcwala emoyeni, kwakhutsata umjikeleto lolandzelako wenjabulo. Lendzawo yekudlala yasebusika bekungumkhosi we adrenaline, imvelo, kanye ne camaraderie, kwenta tinkhumbuto letahlala sikhatsi lesidze ngemuva kwekutsi lichwa lincibilike.

Ngekhatsi kwalelilabhorethri leliyinkimbinkimbi, bososayensi bebahlola ngekucophelela, betsembele ekucinisekeni nasebungcweti. Kusebentisana kanye nekulangatelela kwati kwachuba umsebenti wabo, kuvame kuholela ekuphumeleleni lokungaba nemtselela lomuhle emmangweni. Lendzawo beyiyinhlanganisela yekuhleleka lokulawulwako kanye nekuhlola lokungenamkhawulo, lokufaka umoya wemuntfu wekutfola kanye nekusungula. Wonkhe umphumela waba nesandla ekufuneni lokukhulu kwekuvisisa nekutfutfuka.

Sitolo setincwadzi lesifutfumele lesiseMain Street besibita bantfu labatsandza tincwadzi ngekutsi sibe nebuso lobumemako kanye nemashelufu lagcwele emavolumu. Lendzawo yekuhlala yetincwadzi yakhutsata ummango, kucabanga, kanye nekufundza, yakhulisa tibopho emkhatsini wemagama nalabo labawatsatsa njengalababalulekile.

Ensimini yetitjalo lendze, titjalo letiluhlata letivela emhlabeni wonkhe betikhonjiswa ngetincenye letihlelwe kahle. Tindlela betijikeleta ngemibhedze yetimbali letiphilako, emachibi lathulile, kanye nema arboretums lanemtfunti, kumema kuhlola kanye nekuthula. Balimi bengadze bebanakekela ngelutsandvo sitjalo ngasinye, bacinisekisa kulondvolotwa kwetinhlobo letingakavami kanye nebuhle bendzawo. Tivakashi betimangaliswa kwehlukahlukana kwetitjalo, tifundza ngebudlelwane bemvelo kanye netindlela tekulima. Lengadze yasebenta njengendzawo lengcwele yebantfu labafundzako kanye nebantfu labasha, i-tapestry lephilako yekumangalisa kwemvelo kanye nebuhlakani bebantfu.

Lelipaki lekutijabulisa leliphilako beliniketa injabulo kanye nekubandza ngema- roller coaster alo, emasondvo e- Ferris kanye nemidlalo. Tibane letikhanyako kanye nemculo lojabulisako kwakha umoya lonemdlandla lowadvonsa ticumbi tebantfu letivela edvute nakhashane. Bantfwana nebantfu labadzala ngekufana bahlangabetana netikhatsi tenjabulo kanye nekujabula, batfumba tinkhumbuto emkhatsini wekutijabulisa kanye nekungabi nalokubalulekile. Ema-concession aniketa konkhe kusuka ku-cotton candy kuya ku-snacks lenongotelako, lokukhutsata kuchubeka nekuhlakanipha. Lombukiso wekutijabulisa nekuhleka bewugubha kuba melula kanye nenjabulo yekungcebeleka lokungakhatsateki, kukhumbuta wonkhe umuntfu ngenjabulo letfolakala etintfweni letihlangabetana nato ngekwabelana.

Endzaweni yekungenisa tivakashi lethulile lesemaphandleni, tivakashi betijabulela kuphumula ngekuthula kusuka ekuphitsiteleni kwemphilo yemalanga onkhe. Ifenisha yasemaphandleni kanye nekukhanya lokufutfumele kwakha simo lesitfokotisako, kantsi kudla lokumnandzi kuniketa indvudvuto nekudla. Kungenisa tivakashi kwalomnikati wendlu yetivakashi bekwenta tivakashi titive tikhona futsi tiphumule, bekwenta tivakashi titive tisekhaya. Lendzawo yekuhlala lelula kanye nemvelo yaniketa sikhatsi sekuma lesivuselelako, lephindze ihlanganise bahambi ngesivinini lesihamba kancane, lesingenhloso semphilo yasemaphandleni.

Lemnyuziyamu lebusheleleti, yesimanje beyikhombisa tinhlobonhlobo tebuciko, umlandvo, kanye nemibukiso yesayensi. Tivakashi tahamba ngemibukiso lelungiswe kahle, tihlanganyela netintfo letisebentisanako kanye nemaphaneli lafundzisako. Lesakhiwo sona bekungumsebenti webuciko, kufaka umklamo lomusha kwentela kugcwalisa imibukiso lengekhatsi. Tinhlelo tekufundzisa kanye nemicimbi lekhetsekile bekukhutsata bantfu kutsi babe nelukuluku lekufuna kwati futsi bafundze. Le museum yasebenta njengelibhuloho lelihlanganisa sikhatsi lesengcile, samanje, kanye nelikusasa, kugcugcutela tivakashi kutsi tijabulele kucamba kwebantfu kanye nebuciko kuto tonkhe tifundvo.

Esicongweni sentsaba lebeyithulile, bekunendzawo lencane yekukhontela lebeyibuka indzawo letungeletile, umgodla wayo bewufika esibhakabhakeni. Ema- pilgrim netivakashi bebafika kute batfole indvudvuto, bathandaze nobe bavele bajabulele tintfo letibukeka kahle. Tindvonga tematje kanye netindzawo tangekhatsi letilula bekukhombisa kutfobeka kanye nekuhlonipha, kukhutsata tikhatsi tekuzindla kanye nekuchumana.
